macro_context.market_sentiment: Broadly bullish with record highs across all major indices (S&P 500 ~7,377, Nasdaq ~25,977, Dow crossed 50,000) driven by AI earnings momentum and easing Middle East tensions; intraday choppiness on May 7 as tech strength cooled, but overall trend remains upward with market digesting US-Iran peace deal discussions.
macro_context.fed_outlook: Fed held rates steady at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (Powell's likely final meeting) in an unusually divided 8-4 FOMC vote; inflation cited as elevated partly due to global energy prices, and markets are pricing in no rate changes for the rest of 2026 and into 2027.
macro_context.geopolitical: US-Iran war is the dominant flashpoint — ongoing conflict disrupted energy markets but a 14-point peace memorandum and talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz caused oil to surge ~$100/bbl while simultaneously relieving supply-shock fears; US tariff uncertainty and potential Venezuela intervention also weigh on sentiment.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Morgan Stanley raised price target to $262 on Jan 28, 2026 (equal-weight); HSBC set high target of $280 on March 17, 2026; Barclays, Stifel, and Wells Fargo each affirmed ratings on April 15, 2026. Consensus from 23 analysts is Moderate Buy (11 buy, 6 hold, 0 sell) with average price target ranging $234-$265 across aggregators. No major downgrades found in recent weeks.

web_context.competitor_activity: Key rivals Pfizer, Merck, and AbbVie compete directly with JNJ in oncology, immunology, and vaccines. Pfizer and Merck continue investing in oncology pipeline while AbbVie's Skyrizi and Rinvoq challenge JNJ's Tremfya in immunology. JNJ strengthened its competitive moat via the $3B Halda Therapeutics acquisition (Nov 2025) and a cardiac gene therapy partnership with Lexeo Therapeutics, while its Ottava surgical robot enters a market dominated by Intuitive Surgical's da Vinci. Q1 2026 10% revenue growth suggests JNJ is outperforming many large-cap peers.
web_context.earnings_info: Next earnings report expected approximately July 15, 2026 (some sources cite July 22 — confirm via investor relations). Analyst EPS estimate: ~$2.83-$2.84.
